SNR_convention.estimator: GWOSC preferred/default published summary; no recomputation
SNR_convention.source_priority: Cumulative official GWTC confident entry; latest version of discovery events absent from cumulative
SNR_convention.deduplication: commonName, one selected version per event; O4a GWTC4.0/4.1 never added together
SNR_convention.comparison: inclusive >= on published rounded point estimates; uncertainty not propagated
SNR_convention.population: Official cumulative confident GWTC CBC + additional O4 discovery events; not an all-BBH sample
SNR_convention.excluded: Marginal and third-party catalogs; no alert-only list; no posterior-width or reading-based filter
SNR_convention.limitation: Preferred pipeline differs between releases/events. IMR/network SNR is not windowed ringdown SNR.
